name: Diao Raine
source:
[i]"I believe you're aware, but I'm Biying's woman. One wrong move, and you won't live to see tomorrow."[/i]

[i]Femme Fatal[/i]

A former announcer and reporter for a local station. Her good looks caught Biying's eye, and he made her his mistress. 

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/neonclash/english/characters/]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
